method.domain: exported linear sRGB; not RAW baseline EV
method.registration: log-Y ECC translation then affine, area-downsampled by four
method.fitting: median log LR/IPR luminance ratio of 24x24 spatial tiles; equal scene weights
method.fitting_mask: overlap; both Y .01 to .65; each channel below .97; tile valid >=80%
method.gates: ECC>=.97, affine within .02 of identity, gradient correlation>=.90, >=30 tiles
method.validation: leave-one-scene-out; no held-out scene contributes to its coefficient

limitations: Three high-ISO R7 scenes are not a universal camera calibration
Affine registration and filtering cannot remove demosaicing or nonlinear lens differences
Output gain cannot recover clipped details; not interchangeable with pre-DCP baseline exposure
No production changes or image writes; paired metrics are filtered-grid measurements

candidate.scope: R7 / Camera Neutral / supplied high-ISO corpus; experimental, not installed
